entries.title: Headhunter

emulation.emulator: Flycast or Redream; PCSX2 for the PS2 port
emulation.notes: Use a Dreamcast emulator with an owned copy for the primary route. Use PCSX2 only if checking the later PS2 port.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Dreamcast presentation with emulator-side resolution and capture improvements.

primary.why: The Dreamcast release is the original version, while the PS2 version is a later, repurposed port; the Dreamcast version is the better-regarded original.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned Dreamcast copy on original hardware, or use Flycast/Redream with an owned disc image for clean capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced official remaster, remake, PC port, or modern rerelease was identified.

entries.title: Headhunter Redemption

emulation.emulator: xemu; PCSX2 for the PS2 version
emulation.notes: The Xbox version is playable on xemu with minor issues. PCSX2 is a fallback route for the PS2 release.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Xbox presentation with emulator-side resolution improvements.

primary.why: Headhunter Redemption shipped on PS2 and Xbox with no sourced exclusive-content split. The Xbox version is the stronger preservation/capture target because the original Xbox build is playable in xemu and avoids the PS2 version's lower sixth-generation hardware ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned Xbox copy on original Xbox hardware, or use xemu with an owned copy. Use the PS2 release in PCSX2 only as a fallback.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced official remaster, remake, PC port, or modern Xbox backward-compatible rerelease was identified.
